notes: 2018_02_institutional_handbook_index.txt is an index of links holding no policy text.

Version: the saved policy is a 2022 Wayback capture of PolicyStat ID 7304530, Effective 03/2015, Last Revised 03/2015 (older-version approvals 08/2017, 10/2017, 07/2018 with Last Revised unchanged); read as in force on 2018-02-22. The handbook index (capture 2017-11-13) lists the same 'Faculty Parental Leave Policy'.

The CFRA and PDL statute texts saved are 2026 versions; the lengths used (12 workweeks; not to exceed four months) are the baseline's verified values. CFRA's employer threshold in the saved text (five or more) is later than 2018; not used.
FMLA and CFRA are not named but are referred to as 'the 12-week leave period mandated by Federal and State law'; coded as components (U4) with lengths from the statutes (U2).

Option 1 (one-course reduction, full pay) and option 2 (full semester's leave at 75%) are alternatives (in_lieu_of); option 3 (unpaid continuation, considered on request) follows the compensated leave; a negotiated alternative arrangement is in_lieu_of both options.
'Such leaves are limited to one per event' renews with each birth or adoption: not a use limit (U9).

Birth parent chain: semester's leave at 75% (c2) with PDL (c6, up to 4 months) alongside from its start, VDI (c7) within PDL from week 2 bringing pay to 100%, then 75% to the end of the semester; CFRA (c9) after PDL; FMLA (c8) alongside c2 and c6; optional unpaid continuation (c3) after c2. Option 1 (c1) or the negotiated arrangement (c4) in lieu of c2.

Non-birth parent chain: semester's leave at 75% (c2) with FMLA (c8) and CFRA (c9) alongside; optional unpaid continuation (c3) after c2. Option 1 (c1) or the negotiated arrangement (c4) in lieu of c2.

Cited but not saved: the short-term disability (VDI) plan; the handbook index's 'Sabbatical Leave Policy', 'Faculty Employment Status Definitions' and 'Academic Calendar' (none needed for the parental provisions). No HR leave policy (sick leave, staff leave) appears in the saved index.

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
